adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: The code changes from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the find() will never match any calendar (since no calendar has externalId === undefined), so selectedCalendar becomes undefined. Previously, when externalCalendarId was falsy, it would fall back to `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` which would use the destination calendar's externalId. This is a logic bug where legacy bookings without externalCalendarId will now get undefined instead of the destination calendar.
